comparison.objective: Remove a sample from a warm cryostat without venting the cold cryostat; the candidate adjusts a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Sample transfer with valve/chamber interlock reasoning, not threaded two-tool manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Sample is retrieved while the cold chamber remains protected; complete numeric thresholds are not present in the indexed body.
comparison.reason: The physical and procedural safety mechanism differs fundamentally.
